rules.flow: 6 completed 4h candles: taker buy quote / total quote >=0.55 long or <=0.45 short; 24h price change same direction >=2%; first threshold crossing only
rules.oi: last available snapshot strictly before signal decision; <=8h old; compare with snapshot 24h earlier; increase >=1%; never substitute volume for OI
rules.funding: last realized rate strictly before decision, <=16h old; side*rate <=0.0003; not predicted future rate

historical: 2023-01 through 2026-06, 38 fixed symbols, already explored. Only flow and funding available in local archive; do not claim OI backtest.
recent: Short previously untested window, 5 prespecified liquid symbols. No optimization after observing results. Incomplete month returns not monthly sustainable estimates.
promotion: No live promotion from this short window. Require long independent evaluation and realistic execution.
